pages.text: The Potion Table: sample ≥25 purity + solids + life energy → akaishi potion; the potion inherits the sample's creature source and purity.$(br2)$(2,4)Permanent Potion$(0): absorbs that creature's genotype (no side effects) — all organs of that source gain +2~+10 compatibility by purity; each genotype is absorbed once per lifetime, up to 4 at once, and can be re-absorbed after unloading in the Gene Manager.$(br)$(2,4)Breakthrough Potion$(0): requires that source's genotype already absorbed AND a non-native organ of that source transplanted; activates for 30 min — base stats +10%~40%, extra compatibility +2~+8 (tiered by purity), negative-base-value traits temporarily disabled. At most 1 active at a time, can end early, re-activatable after expiry.

Purity tiers: 0-20 → permanent +2 / breakthrough +2 comp·+10%; 21-40 → +4 / +4·20%; 41-60 → +6 / +6·30%; 61-80 → +8 / +8·40%; 81-100 → permanent +10.$(br2)Drinking requires meeting the prerequisites (gene slots / absorbed genes / transplanted same-source organ); the potion is not consumed if unmet.$(br2)$(2,4)Effective compatibility$(0) = organ's own compatibility + that source's gene bonus (capped 100), plus extra compatibility during breakthrough that can temporarily exceed 100, falling back when it expires.

The Gene Manager lists absorbed genotypes and the currently active breakthrough (with live remaining time and boosted-organ count).$(br2)Unload a gene: removes that source's bonus and frees a slot (re-absorb anytime by drinking the permanent potion); if it's powering a breakthrough, that breakthrough ends too.$(br)End button: ends the current breakthrough early without losing the gene, then you can reactivate right away. Want to "change skins"? Come unload here first.
